title: Advanced Topics Practice 2
statement:
Module 5 (Advanced Topics) covers: css architecture, capstone: style a page, css performance, css dark mode patterns, css animation libraries, css for print. Solve this practice problem using what you learned.

Exercise 2: write a small program that demonstrates one concept from this module (Capstone: Style a Page).
hints: Re-read the Capstone: Style a Page lesson example.
Start by declaring your variables, then add the core logic.
Test with the simplest input first, then edge cases.
solutionExplanation: A correct solution applies the module concepts in a small working program.
